data_route: dsImaging admission of image_root asset plus per-image metadata declaring pathology label, label levels and patient privacy unit; three DSLite custodians.

evaluation.aggregation: arithmetic mean and sample SD across three seeds
evaluation.alternative: None. One corrected schedule, no post-score alternative.
evaluation.central_schedule: Converged fixed C=1 L2 logistic head on pooled mean features of all 852 training patients, unpenalized intercept, L-BFGS-B maxiter10000 ftol1e-12 gtol1e-9. Equivalent symmetric 512-to-2 logits; shared deterministic fit across all seeds/epsilons.
evaluation.diagnostic: AUC > 0.5 and accuracy > held-out majority-class rate; report per-replicate and three-seed mean comparison.
evaluation.pooled_dp: Unchanged released _dp_fit on all 852 pooled patient records, selected schedule and five rounds; same epsilon/delta/clip, freshly calibrated pooled geometry. Logical full-site batch is 852, q=1 and ten updates.
evaluation.test_policy: One locked scoring pass after all nine final fits and all twins are complete; no held-out metadata/images/split file access in R5 before that pass. No scored cell rerun and no further alternative.
twins: Converged fixed C=1 L2 logistic head on pooled mean features of all 852 training patients, unpenalized intercept, L-BFGS-B maxiter10000 ftol1e-12 gtol1e-9. Equivalent symmetric 512-to-2 logits; shared deterministic fit across all seeds/epsilons.

Three-site FedAvg with selected schedule and identical initial head; same Poisson sampling and expected-batch divisor; clipping and noise removed; optimizer reset every round. Shared across epsilon within each seed.
Unchanged released _dp_fit on all 852 pooled patient records, selected schedule and five rounds; same epsilon/delta/clip, freshly calibrated pooled geometry.
Training-image majority and prevalence for primary image metrics; training-patient majority and prevalence for secondary patient metrics.
evaluation.nonprivate_federated: Three-site FedAvg with selected schedule and identical initial head; same Poisson sampling and expected-batch divisor; clipping and noise removed; optimizer reset every round. Shared across epsilon within each seed.
evaluation.secondary_unit: patient-mean features and modal label; annotation only; same fixed models, evaluated within the one scoring pass

instrumentation: Public-only observer copies of the segmentation/sequence harness: seed/capture analyst initialization; observe node accountant inputs/steps and public tensor hashes after the mandatory runner integrity gate. No replacement of training, privacy calibration, clipping or sampling.

model.bounds_policy: Released image transform and fixed feature totalization; no data-derived feature bounds.
model.head: linear 512 to 2; cross_entropy

model_params_policy: DP-aware 736-schedule emulator ranking on training patients only; top three confirmed under actual epsilon-8 federation; select highest actual patient inner-validation AUC.
patient_training: Released runner averages frozen features within patient and takes deterministic modal label before patient DP-SGD. Source pathology labels are consistent within patient according to archived audit.
randomness: Outer split/site membership fixed at 20260919. Public seeds 20260919/20/21 control initial heads; node-owned cryptographic randomness controls DP sampling/noise. No campaign-wide privacy composition claim.

release.change_scope: Server import guard only; canonical runner and all training, sampling, clipping and privacy settings unchanged.

split.policy: Fix the archived 20260919 outer split and its three original sites for all three initialization/training seeds. No cross-seed repartitioning.
split.split_source: Only prepared/vision/20260919 training collections were read during diagnosis. Original full split JSON is opened only after the final exclusive scoring lock.

diagnosis.selection_rule: Maximum actual federated-DP patient inner-validation AUC at epsilon 8; tie candidate id ascending.

logical_batch: full_site: 227 inner, 284 federated outer, 852 pooled outer; q=1, ten updates
